scope: P8 application manifest, scoped server grant, message action and immediate revocation browser acceptance.
environment: Own Ego Lite task space 12, web 3131 and freshly built isolated SQLite API 9191. Only the disposable p1_acceptance fixture and its isolated acceptance database were used.
checks: Created a disposable application through the account settings UI, observed the one-time credential warning, hid the credential and saved a test-enabled message-action manifest.
Installed the application into the disposable test server with read_message and send_response scopes and observed the persisted installation in server settings.
Opened a real channel message context menu and observed the installed Özetle action. Invoking it produced an immediate localized queued toast.
Revoked the installation through the confirmation dialog. A stale pre-refresh menu invocation was rejected by the server and produced a localized error toast.

After loading the final client bundle, reinstallation made the action appear without a page reload and revocation removed it from the message menu without a page reload. This verifies the settings-to-chat refresh event and immediate server-side enforcement.
Closed the Ego Lite task space after the acceptance run. The disposable application remains only in the isolated acceptance database and has no active server grant.
remaining: A real separately connected bot process must complete an invocation in two-client acceptance.
release: Local acceptance only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
